title: Console host integration files
responsibility: Produces SvelteKit server modules and routes that connect the console to a host policy and bundled or private-bucket history.

inputs.name: consoleHostFiles.options
inputs.description: Selects the host route base and the module/export that supplies its console policy, with an optional private bucket binding and prefix for history. The function interpolates these values into generated paths and TypeScript source and performs no validation.

outputs.name: consoleServerDirectory
outputs.description: Fixed host-relative directory used for the generated server module and console data modules. Its value is `src/lib/server/harness`.

outputs.name: consoleHostFiles
outputs.description: The function returns five `{ path, contents }` entries: one server module, root and catch-all document routes, and data and media routes under `base`. It returns generated source strings without writing files; omitting `bucket` embeds bundle globs, while supplying it generates a private-bucket reader.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The generated bucket-backed `data(event)` function throws `Error` when the configured binding is absent from `event.platform.env`. The `consoleHostFiles` call only creates this source and does not run that check.
